description: Every substitution returned by the initialized solver fixes each variable absent from the input equations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify_fixes_outside.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L)
  (μ : ℕ → L.Term ℕ) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify P = some μ) (x : ℕ)
  (hx : x ∉ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.problemVars P) : μ x = FirstOrder.Language.var x
